subject: Reserve sponsorship request: 12hr concurrency sweep for Brightline POC
messages:
From: Sam Carter <sam.carter@brightline.ai>
To: David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00Z
Subject: POC request — 12hr concurrency sweep (Oct 10)

Hey David,

Quick note — the Brightline infra team wants to run a full 12-hour concurrency sweep on the POC environment next Saturday (Oct 10). The goal is to validate 95th/99th latency under sustained traffic (10k concurrent sessions) and capture p95/p99 token/throughput deltas.

We're almost at the final sign-off but the test will need a temporary quota increase / promotional sandbox credits to avoid throttling. Can Redwood sponsor a short-term reserve (we estimate ~1.2M tokens or the equivalent safety buffer)? If so, we can proceed with the final schedule and share the load-plan.

Attached: Brightline_MAT.pdf (short threat model + SOC questions), and a preliminary load plan.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Sam
Sam Carter
Head of ML Infrastructure, Brightline AI
(sam.carter@brightline.ai)
(Attachment: Brightline_MAT.pdf)
(Attachment: load-plan-12hr.csv)

From: David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Carter <sam.carter@brightline.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:03:00Z
Subject: Fwd: POC request — 12hr concurrency sweep (Oct 10)

Marissa / Dylan / Karthik — forwarding Brightline's ask. TL;DR: 12-hour sustained concurrency sweep, ~10k concurrent sessions, estimated 1.2M token consumption. They want a short-term reserve/credit buffer and SOC artifact confirmation.

Questions for approvals:
- Marissa, can we do a promotional reserve for a weekend 12hr sweep? If yes, what delta (tokens / dollars) is reasonable as a sponsored safety buffer?
- Dylan, will this require a temporary quota change on the hosted account or a dedicated promo voucher? Any ops constraints for Saturday runs?
- Karthik, brightline is security-conscious — they attached a MAT and SOC questions. Do we need to loop Legal/Security for evidence or a short attestation?

I'm proposing "reserve sponsorship" of a mid-tier buffer (e.g., 1.2M tokens) with automatic rollback after 48 hours. This is strategic — Brightline is in late-stage procurement and close to committing to Redwood Dedicated if latency numbers look good.

Sam — copying you so you're in the loop. If we can confirm by EOD tomorrow we'll lock the Oct 10 slot.

-David
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: load-plan-12hr.csv)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T14:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC request — 12hr concurrency sweep (Oct 10)

Thanks for the context, David.

I support providing a sponsored reserve for Brightline but want to limit exposure and tie it to measurable gates. Proposed approach:
- Approve a temporary promo voucher equivalent to 1.2M tokens OR $3,000 of sandbox credit (whichever we hit first).
- Require they submit the finalized load plan and a short checklist (test start/end times, telemetry hooks, and success criteria) 48 hours before run.
- If they request more than the buffer, escalate to me for a one-time top-up.

Dylan — please confirm whether a promo voucher is the cleanest execution path (instead of manual quota change). Also include any blackout windows for weekend ops.

Karthik — please review the MAT attachment and flag any security docs we must provide before test window. If Legal needs to be included, loop them.

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
(Attachment referenced: Brightline_MAT.pdf)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Carter <sam.carter@brightline.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T15:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC request — 12hr concurrency sweep (Oct 10)

All — Ops confirmed we can issue a time-limited promo voucher for sandbox credits that will auto-expire 48 hours after issuance. Implementation notes:
- Voucher ID: PROMO-BRI-10K-12H (provisional).
- Credit equiv: 1.2M tokens (~$3,000).
- Activation: I'll provision the voucher to Brightline's hosted account and set it to active Oct 09 16:00 UTC so they can do a final smoke test before the main run on Oct 10 02:00 UTC.
- Telemetry: please ensure they have tracing enabled against our ingest endpoints and that the preflight checklist is uploaded to the HubSpot deal (we'll add a task).

Karthik — ops will not provide SOC documents; if they need artifacts beyond the MAT, Legal/Security will need to issue. Let me know and I will create an exec escalation.

Sam — I'll send the voucher code and activation window once Marissa signs off on the exact limits.

Dylan Brooks
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: provisioning-notes.txt)

From: Sam Carter <sam.carter@brightline.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T16:03:00Z
Subject: Re: POC request — 12hr concurrency sweep (Oct 10)

Perfect — thanks team. We will:
- Upload final load-plan (CSV) and run checklist to the HubSpot deal by Oct 08 12:00 UTC.
- Confirm telemetry endpoints and any required headers for trace correlation.
- Schedule a 30-minute smoke test Oct 09 18:00 UTC.

Appreciate the quick support — this run is the last technical gate before our procurement commit.

Sam
(Attachment: final-load-plan-12hr.csv)
